hook_text: A building is never just a building. Look closer: every one has a job to do.
clip_script: A walk through Kimberley. A house: a place to live. A kraal: a shelter for cattle. A supermarket: a place to buy food. A school: a place to learn. A clinic: a place to get well. A bank: a place to keep money safe. A church, a mosque, a temple: places to worship. A factory: a place to make things. A station: a place to start a journey. What job does each building in your street do?
visual_style: Whiteboard street drawn as a long strip, with each building popping up and a one-word label showing its use.
mood: Curious, like a treasure hunt down the street.
pacing: Fast tour of nine buildings, a one-word job for each, then the question back to the viewer.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw three buildings from your own street with their uses.
